content: Anyone within striking distance of New Hampshire? I started a meetup there. Still getting our footing but right now shooting for twice a month (one Weds and one Thurs), probably sticking to Dover, at a restaurant/bar just like Boston Open. But I'd like to do presentations at the makerspace in Portsmouth at some point. I have a few ideas there.
But for now we're meeting this week at Charros Mexican Cuisine in Dover NH at 19:00 Thursday July 16!

It was decent. But I think going forward we're going to try for a short show-and-tell. Someone showed off wobbly windows (like we saw 10-15 years ago with Compiz) in Gnome, and I thought it would be cool to do every time.
Next meeting is tonight! Forgot to post until just now.

Next meeting is this week:

  • Thursday Oct 22, 19:00
  • Otto (beer and pizza place) - 431 Central Avenue, Dover NH - https://locations.ottoportland.com/otto-46f7efd90da3

One thing that's special about a place like NH is that there's a lot more interest and knowledge in off-grid living (which intersects nicely with FOSS) and also FOSS farm tech. But we also talk about more familiar topics like privacy, self-hosting and mesh networking.

LMK if we should expect you!
